BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE onboarding_path_execution IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM onboarding_path_execution LIMIT 1) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove onboarding_path_execution while durable execution evidence exists';
  END IF;
END $$;
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_onboarding_path_execution ON onboarding_path_execution;
DROP FUNCTION protect_onboarding_path_execution();
DROP TRIGGER trg_prevent_onboarding_path_execution_delete ON onboarding_path_execution;
DROP FUNCTION prevent_onboarding_path_execution_delete();
DROP TRIGGER trg_prevent_onboarding_path_execution_truncate ON onboarding_path_execution;
DROP FUNCTION prevent_onboarding_path_execution_truncate();
DROP TRIGGER trg_prevent_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content_truncate ON onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content;
DROP FUNCTION prevent_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content_truncate();
DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content ON onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content;
DROP FUNCTION protect_onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content();
DROP TABLE onboarding_path_execution_lesson_content;
DROP TABLE onboarding_path_execution;
ALTER TABLE planner_outbox DROP CONSTRAINT planner_outbox_subject_check;
ALTER TABLE planner_outbox ADD CONSTRAINT planner_outbox_subject_check
CHECK (subject IN ('course.plan.completed', 'course.plan.failed'));
COMMIT;
